programs.title: They Will Kill You
programs.desc: A woman answers a cryptic ad for a housekeeping job at a luxurious yet foreboding New York City high-rise. Upon arrival, she discovers residents have vanished without a trace for decades, fueling whispers of a satanic cult lurking in the shadows.

programs.title: A '90s Christmas
programs.desc: A workaholic lawyer destined to spend Christmas alone is transported back to 1999 after an unexpected run in with a particularly wise ride-share driver.

programs.title: An Autumn Romance
programs.desc: A woman tries to save a small, historic hotel from developers, but she soon realizes that the man she's falling for is behind the hotel's development plans.

programs.title: Strong Fathers, Strong Daughters
programs.desc: When a wealthy businessman learns of his daughter's engagement, he struggles to give up control and trust God with her future.

programs.title: Ailey
programs.desc: Filmmaker Jamila Wignot examines the life of visionary dancer and choreographer Alvin Ailey.

programs.title: Voyagers
programs.desc: With the future of the human race at stake, a group of young men and women -- bred for intelligence and obedience -- embark on an expedition to colonize a distant planet. When they uncover disturbing secrets about the mission, they defy their training and begin to explore their most primitive natures. As life on the ship descends into chaos, they soon become consumed by fear, lust and an insatiable hunger for power.

programs.title: This Time Each Year
programs.desc: Despite a trial separation, Lauren pretends to still be with her husband, Kevin, to placate her overbearing mother. The ruse may be just what the couple needs to finally work on their marriage.

programs.title: The Dark Knight Rises
programs.desc: It has been eight years since Batman (Christian Bale), in collusion with Commissioner Gordon (Gary Oldman), vanished into the night. Assuming responsibility for the death of Harvey Dent, Batman sacrificed everything for what he and Gordon hoped would be the greater good. However, the arrival of a cunning cat burglar (Anne Hathaway) and a merciless terrorist named Bane (Tom Hardy) force Batman out of exile and into a battle he may not be able to win.

programs.title: Freud's Last Session
programs.desc: On the eve of World War II, Sigmund Freud and C.S. Lewis gather to discuss the existence of God and the future of mankind.

programs.title: Transplant
programs.desc: Bash finds himself at odds with his direct supervisor while they treat a couple of skydivers with a unique relationship; Mags speaks out against her supervising doctor; a mistake comes back to bite Theo.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: Lacey plans a parade for Dog River Days with all the fixings; Wanda uses a mascot to convince a corporate sponsor to support the cause; Hank battles Emma for the beauty pageant crown.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: Brent accidentally locks Hank and Wanda in Corner Gas; Emma tries to get out of making Davis's special bread.
